propositions: The old code ran os.makedirs(ticket_dir) outside the write lock before the first event file was written, leaving a window where interruption strands an empty ticket directory visible to fsck scanners.
New staging module atomically creates ticket directory and first event in a dot-prefixed temporary path, then publishes them together with one os.rename under the write lock.

Temporary staging paths (.tmp-newticket-*) are invisible to existing fsck scanners by naming convention without requiring scanner changes, leveraging the same dot-prefix exclusion rule already applied to .tmp-event-* files.

batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, and dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT emission are converted to the same atomic staging pattern, closing the makedirs-then-die window in all store write paths.
sweep_stale_staging bounded best-effort cleans only writer-owned staging dirs when the owner process is provably dead, respecting the 043f boundary that prohibits cleanup of committed store data.
